subsystem: M846-M865 Historical Battle Data Deep Integration

improvements.description: M846: Deepen Seraphine LCU connector pattern - add WebSocket event subscription following Seraphine's LcuWebSocket.subscribe() pattern for real-time data push
M846: Add Fiddler MCP Server integration layer - HTTP traffic analysis via localhost:8868/mcp with ApiKey auth, HAR export parsing, and request classification
M846: Implement self-evolution feedback loop - capture module performance metrics, feed into GovernedEnvironment.step() reward signal for PPO training cycle
M846: Add async data pipeline with asyncio.gather() for parallel Riot API requests, following Seraphine's concurrent fetch pattern
M846: Add comprehensive input validation layer with schema enforcement for all Riot API response parsing, preventing silent data corruption
M846: Integrate OpenTelemetry spans for distributed tracing across the M846-M865 subsystem, connecting to agentlightning/tracer/otel.py
M846: Implement multi-tier cache (L1 memory LRU + L2 disk sqlite) with configurable TTL per endpoint and cross-module cache invalidation bus
M846: Add Proxifier configuration validator - verify LoL client traffic routing through Fiddler proxy, detect certificate pinning issues
M846: Build cross-match correlation engine connecting historical battle data to real-time game state for predictive analysis
